transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I came in because the last few weeks I just haven’t had much of an appetite. Even stuff I usually like after a shift, I’ll make it or pick it up, and then it just sits there. I end up forcing down a few bites and that’s about it.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah… most days I’ve been feeling pretty low. It’s like this heavy, flat feeling I’m carrying around. Even when I’m at home with my family or just sitting in the break room at work, I feel kind of checked out, like I’m not really there.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to really look forward to my morning runs, playing guitar, cooking dinner… stuff like that. Lately I just keep skipping it. It all feels like a chore, and I can’t really get myself to care about it.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

I’m not planning to hurt myself, no. But… I do get these thoughts sometimes, like maybe if I didn’t wake up, it wouldn’t be the worst thing. Like I wouldn’t have to keep pushing through feeling like this.
Have you been feeling this way nearly every day for at least two weeks?
Yeah. It’s been pretty much every day for about three weeks now. It started around when the casino reorganized our security operations and changed my assignments.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?
I’m not really sure. I mean, my sleep hasn’t stood out to me as the main problem. I guess some nights aren’t great, but I haven’t been keeping track.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah, I have. When I’m watching the CCTV feeds, my mind drifts off, and then I realize I missed something or I’m not really following what I’m looking at. And with incident reports, I keep having to reread what I wrote or what happened, over and over. I’ve made a few mistakes I normally wouldn’t make.
Have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual?

Yeah… I think so. People at work have mentioned I’m moving slower in briefings, and I’ve noticed I take longer to answer when someone asks me something. It’s like my body and my mouth are both a step behind everybody else.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I get tired sometimes like anyone after a shift, but I haven’t noticed it being unusually bad or anything I could clearly point to.
Have you been feeling worthless or blaming yourself a lot lately?
I don’t think so. I get frustrated with myself when I mess something up, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been feeling worthless or blaming myself a lot.
Have you been worrying a lot lately?
I don’t think I’ve been worrying a lot, no. I mean, I have normal stuff on my mind, but nothing that feels excessive or out of control.
Have you lost any weight since your appetite went down?

I haven’t really checked my weight, so I’m not sure if I’ve lost any. I just know my appetite’s been pretty low the last few weeks—stuff I usually like after work, I kind of just stare at it and force a few bites.
Before the work assignment changes happened, were you already feeling depressed?
No, not really. I’d say it started after the casino reorganized the security operations and changed my assignments. It’s been about three weeks since then.
Have you been feeling hopeless lately?
Yeah… I don’t know if I’d call it hopeless exactly, but most days I’ve got this heavy, flat feeling. Even when I’m home with my family or sitting in the break room, I feel like I’m not really there.
Has this been making it hard for you to function at work or at home?

Yeah. I mean, I’m still going in and doing the basic parts of the job, but it’s not like me lately. I’ve made some documentation mistakes, and I missed a surveillance cue. I ended up getting a formal warning over it, so… yeah, it’s starting to affect work in a way it never really has before. At home I’m getting by, but work is where it’s showing up the most.
Have you noticed your clothes fitting looser lately?

Yeah, a little. Mostly I’ve noticed I just don’t have much appetite these last few weeks. Even food I usually want after a shift, I’ll just sit there and force down a few bites. So I guess my clothes may be a bit looser, but the appetite is what I’ve really noticed.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t been hearing voices or seeing things like that.
Have you been unable to get out of bed or take care of basic things like showering or eating because of how depressed you feel?

Not really to that point. I’m still getting up, going in, and doing the basic stuff. It’s more that I’m slipping at work—made some documentation mistakes, missed a surveillance cue, and got a formal warning. So I’m functioning, but not like I usually do.
Have you actually lost weight during these last few weeks?

I’m not sure exactly how much, I haven’t really weighed myself. What I do know is I’ve barely had an appetite the last few weeks. Even stuff I usually like after work, I’ll just pick at it and force down a few bites.
Do you find yourself mainly upset about the changes in your work assignment?
Yeah, mostly. It’s been going on about three weeks now, since the casino reorganized the security operations and changed my assignments. That’s when I started feeling this way.
